Game Overview

Blokku is a block game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Blokku is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Blokku?

Blokku is a free block game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Blokku free to play?

Yes, Blokku is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
